messages:
Emma CSM: Quick check-in — Spend-Sentinel flagged Polaris (acct pol-882) for a hosted-API commit overage overnight. Auto-alert fired at 03:14 UTC. Attaching quick notes. :warning:

Raj Ops: I pulled the alert. Anomaly score 0.98, sustained token rate spike starting ~02:50 UTC. Latency p50/p95 stayed within SLOs, so this looks like high volume not retries. Dashboard: <https://console.redwood.internal/accounts/polaris/usage> :eyes:

Maria Finance: Rough numbers? how far past committed monthly tokens are they projected? need to flag renewal risk if this keeps up.

Oliver Data: Ran a fast query against recent usage buckets:
```
-- results truncated
2026-03-18: 120k tokens
2026-03-19: 150k tokens
2026-03-20: 3.8M tokens
2026-03-21: 4.1M tokens
```
Looks like an ingestion/reindex job started on 03/20. The bulk of the calls are to `v1/generate` with long contexts.

Ben Eng: Any signs of client-side looping or duplication? Could be a stray batch job calling embeddings/generate repeatedly.

Emma CSM: Customer CSM notes: they onboarded a new data pipeline last week, was told they'd throttle at client side but maybe misconfigured. I pinged their engineering lead.

Raj Ops: Quick triage steps I ran: checked recent API keys for high throughput, found key `sk-pol-882-ingest` with 98% of the volume. Originating IPs cluster to a small CIDR from their cloud vendor. No obvious retry storms in logs.

Oliver Data: Breakdown by endpoint: 85% `generate`, 10% `embeddings`, 5% misc. Median prompt length is 1.2k tokens — long prompts. Suspect a batch job doing full-corpus generation rather than incremental.

Maria Finance: If this runs for a month at current rate they'd be ~62x committed monthly spend. We should prepare a billing outreach and temporary overage plan.

Ben Eng: I can add a temporary per-key soft cap (not a hard kill) and a 30% request-rate reduction on that key to buy time. Anyone object?

Emma CSM: Please do. Also propose we apply short-term quota: 500k tokens/day for `sk-pol-882-ingest` until we validate. I'll notify the customer and offer debug support. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-4572 — "Polaris hosted spend sentinel: temporary quota + customer outreach". Assigned to Ben Eng, Raj Ops, Emma CSM. Temporary rate-limit applied: 20 rps, token cap 500k/day on key `sk-pol-882-ingest`. Ticket link: <https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/CS-4572>

Raj Ops: I also rolled a small telemetry tweak to flag large-context calls (context_tokens > 2048) for daily digest. That should help catch these earlier.

Oliver Data: Added a one-off alert in the spend pipeline: if daily tokens > 2M and > 5x baseline, send high-priority channel ping + CSV export of top keys.

Maria Finance: I'll draft a short billing notice with overage projection and safety-net pricing. Emma, can you include the customer-confirmed maintenance window so we don't double-charge for an authorized bulk run?

Emma CSM: Doing that now — pinged their eng lead: "we see a large ingestion run from your new ETL; can you confirm this was expected or rollback?" Will update thread when they reply.

Ben Eng: On engineering tasks: I'll add a temporary rule in the rate-limiter and a lightweight sampling logger for that key to capture full request headers (no payload). Helps us root-cause without storing PII. ETA 2h.

Emma CSM: Team action items: 1) Ben apply soft cap + sampling (in progress), 2) Raj keep monitoring and escalate if >1M tokens/hour, 3) Maria prepare invoice draft + protection clause, 4) Oliver keep the CSV exports running, 5) I'll coordinate with the customer and confirm expected runs.

Raj Ops: Current status in 30m: tokens dropped 55% after soft cap, still above baseline. Will watch for retry loops. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Emma CSM: Great. If the customer confirms a planned bulk job we'll offer a one-time block purchase with a discounted overage rate. Otherwise we'll treat as unplanned and follow standard overage policy.

Maria Finance: Noted — prepping options and will post a short FAQ we can send.

Emma CSM: Follow-up: scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to close loop. If anything spikes before then, escalate to #incidents. Closing updates here once resolved. Thanks everyone. :wave:
